author: GamingBolt
description:
With the NFL season around the corner, it’s about time for another Madden game. This year’s entry introduces some overhauls to Franchise mode and some interesting on- field tweaks to give you a bit more control. 

Here are 15 things I wish I knew when I started Madden 27.
title: EA Sports Madden NFL 27 - 15 Things It Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
There's still that Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls needs to learn, and even if it reportedly doesn't have the same numbers as PlayStation's biggest hits (never mind measuring up to FighterZ), I'm hoping it will continue to evolve. New characters will introduce brand-new strategies and probably change how the meta works, but the real test will be in how ArcSys approaches the fundamentals. 

Will combos become much more challenging to execute, requiring even more work to master? Will Crossover receive changes and feel less like the de facto defensive tactic? Will Peni ever escape from C Tier? Time will tell, and for now, it feels like Tōkon's journey is only beginning.
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - WHY Are So Many Gamers ADDICTED?

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re quite close to the debut of a franchise that has a lot of potential to become a modern favorite thanks to the talent at its core working to make it a special addition to open-world action titles. 

We’re talking about The Blood of Dawnwalker of course, a game that could become the vampire experience we’ve often wanted over the years. If you’re thinking about picking up a copy, which is a very tempting proposition with each new trailer, we’ve put together a new list of things we’ve learned about the game since our last one.

It’s worth a look if you’re on the fence, and you’re sure to find new ways to hype yourself up for the game even if you’re still going to wait for the reviews. Join us for another trip to Vale Sangora to see what it’s throwing at us next month.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - 15 MORE NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
